lens: Deep-learning researcher in operator learning / scientific ML: a first-principles analysis of learning the geometry -> interface Schur complement (discrete Dirichlet-to-Neumann operator) map for the CutFEM TPMS super-element, grounded in the project's measured facts (2026-09-11..16) and the repository's own experiment records.
principles: P1 Division of labour: the network should predict only quantities that are local functions of geometry, O(1) after a geometry-computable scaling, and needed to ~1e-2 relative accuracy; the precision-critical, global part of the map (the elimination that produces the near/far cancellation and the far field) is exact linear algebra inside the model, in fp64. S = K_bb - K_bi K_ii^-1 K_ib: all non-locality enters through K_ii^-1, and soft-mode stiffness is a 1e3-1e4 cancellation [STRUCTURE OF S]; a model that predicts the two parts separately pays ~1e-4 per entry [ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS], a model that computes the difference does not.

P2 Structure by construction, not by loss: SPD, exact rigid null space, cube-group equivariance and Galerkin monotonicity belong in the parameterisation. Rigid invariance by construction is what removed the 38.8% diagonal attractor [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]; augmentation-only equivariance left V1 numerically singular on an unseen symmetric frame.

P3 The acceptance metric is a maximum over 12,792 directions in the teacher energy norm; no averaged loss (Frobenius, D/d, action-MSE) can certify it (D/d 1.27e-5 vs eps_op 0.229, 3 deciding modes) [METRIC]. Training needs a bulk term for conditioning plus explicit extreme-direction terms with Hellmann-Feynman/adjoint gradients.

P4 Work in the multiplicative gauge: additive error on A is amplified by cond(A) = 7.2e4, multiplicative error on the factor is not (eps_op ~ 1.42 ||Delta||) [METRIC]; R* whitening in the loss makes the Hessian ~identity, which is why Newton with column scaling converged and raw Adam NaN'd [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]. Never form A additively in fp32.

P5 Bandwidth and near-field regression are not levers; the correct multiscale prior is 'local operator + global elimination' (H^2/FE structure), not 'near field dense + far field low rank as independent regression targets'. The H-matrix of R* passes at 15% of dense with three quarters of its numbers in the far field [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a].

P6 The number of learned global outputs must be << number of training cells; everything global must be computed (a solve) or come from a low-dimensional, densely sampled local descriptor space. Per-node/per-element heads with weight sharing turn 33 cells into ~1e5-1e6 examples; global heads turn them into 33.

P7 Learnability is a property of the target as much as of the learner: the current GP labels jump by 60% in one direction under a 1e-4 relative geometry change [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]; under an unfloored worst-direction gate no continuous surrogate can pass across a neighbourhood of geometry. The fix is in the inputs (exact discrete state), the representation (compute the boundary layer exactly), the labels (continuous stabilisation) or the contract (stiffness floor / task-level), not in capacity.

P8 Local labels from local fine solves are the data engine: assembly is cheap (0.44 s per full cell), patch condensations are milliseconds, and local geometry is densely sampled inside every cell even though the 33 (or 1024) global geometries are sparse in a ~12-D parameter space.

P9 Cheap, decisive pre-training diagnostics exist and must run before any large network: noise-sensitivity of the representation's coefficients, identifiability of fitted coefficients against local geometry, Loewner ceilings of coarse spaces (oracle tools), two-teacher (gamma -> 2 gamma) spectra to find stabilisation-defined modes.
implications_for_representation: Reject flat heads (>=2e10 weights), softmax attention as the operator's form (wrong sign/rank structure), and per-entry regression of S or of a Cholesky factor as the sole mechanism (factor entries are non-local elimination products; ~1e-4 per entry required; no SPD for S). Keep the H-matrix as the storage/compression format and evaluation reference, not as the primary learning target (12-14M numbers per cell at ~1e-4 each, far-field blocks carry the cancellation, SVD factors are gauge-non-unique; fixed-rank parameter count still unmeasured). The representation that satisfies P1/P2 is 'predicted local SPD energy + exact condensation': the network emits per-coarse-cell (later per-collar-patch) SPD blocks as log-Cholesky corrections around a geometry-computed baseline; assembly gives exact rigid null space and SPD; Galerkin structure gives a known error sign (zero-learning collar mu in [1.000, 1.855]); the exact condensation produces the far field and the cancellation in fp64. Its measured floor is eps_op 0.15 with 23k numbers and its measured ceiling (one-layer collar + Q1 core) is mu_max >= 1.111, so the core must be enriched (Q2 core, per-cell local element matrices from oversampled local solves in a GMsFEM-like enriched basis that can hold thin-material modes no fixed geometric basis contains, or a PSD softening term whose rank is set by the count of modes above the Galerkin bound); every enrichment can be priced by the Loewner-bound tool before training. Cost: the condensation is 0.076x the teacher's factorisation (62k dofs, 0.73 s + ~4 s Schur export); the fine collar assembly (17.7 s) and pre-elimination (7.7 s) are local, parallel engineering items or a second learned local head (collar Schur complements are local labels). Output scaling is part of the representation: predicted compliance (R^2 0.98 in-cell, leave-one-seat spread median 16.8) for factor-like outputs, homogenised tensors for material-like outputs.
implications_for_loss_and_metric: Train on the whitened operator M = R*^-T Ahat R*^-1 with (i) a bulk term (D/d or its quadratic form) for conditioning and (ii) explicit extreme-direction terms: warm-started block Lanczos/LOBPCG with 32-64 modes per end (stiff end on M, soft end on M^-1, i.e. solves with Ahat, which are cheap sparse solves for a condensation-type model), hinge/barrier psi_eps(|mu-1|) with curriculum eps 0.3 -> 0.1 -> 0.03, gradients by Hellmann-Feynman (d mu/d theta = w^T (dAhat/dtheta) w, w = R*^-1 v detached), which for a condensation model becomes the strain energy of the worst modes' K-harmonic extensions in each element (adjoint sensitivity, O(k) solves per step). Optionally an eigenvector-free Hutchinson spectral-moment term E_z[z^T (M-I)^(2p) z] (p = 8, 16 probes, ~256 matvecs, 0.1-1 s). Whiten with R* only in the loss, never in the forward model; compute R* by Cholesky for all 1024 packet geometries. Metric: eps_op stays the module gate; D/d is a diagnostic; s* = 2/(mu_max+mu_min) rescaling is a teacher-dependent diagnostic only. Add a floored/shifted variant (the evaluator's --shift-c) to express a stiffness-floored contract, with the floor set by a gamma -> 2 gamma two-teacher test and confirmed on the 2-cell harness with adjoint sensitivities, because TO consumes derivatives that are first-order in the operator error.
implications_for_data_and_teacher: Highest leverage, cheapest action: factor all 1024 condensed S packets (Cholesky, 7e11 flops at d = 12.8k, up to ~3.5e13 flops / 9 GB at q = 47.8k; hours on one GPU), giving 1024 whitening metrics and, with the exact 48-fold cube symmetry, ~49k cell-level examples (respecting the registered splits; the frozen holdout is never used for screening). Build a local-label engine: per coarse cell / boundary patch, the exact oversampled local Schur complement of the fine content onto the coarse basis (milliseconds each, ~1e3 per cell, x1024 cells x48 symmetries ~ 5e7 labels) as identifiable, piecewise-smooth targets; per-node compliance and near-field blocks from the existing packets. Feed the exact discrete state (active-cell mask, GP-face graph, cut volume fractions) as input channels, since the label map jumps at active-set changes. Register local-descriptor coverage against the TO design range and generate cells where it is missing (32 s + assembly each); add CUT labels before any CUT claim (none of the 33 factors is CUT). Teacher: the softest modes (lambda < ~1e-6) sit at the ghost-penalty energy scale (1e-4 x mean stiffness 7.9e-3 ~ 8e-7 ~ lambda_min 4.9e-7), which is the plausible mechanism for the 60% jump per 1e-4 geometry change; test it with a gamma -> 2 gamma whitened spectrum. Then either regenerate labels with a continuous stabilisation (smooth partition-of-unity weight replacing the hard classifier whose 1e-12 shift moved mu_max to 1.25; qualify by measuring the eps_op-Lipschitz constant at delta = 1e-4..1e-2 on a few paths) or register a stiffness-floored / task-level contract. Label precision: S packets are float32 (rounding floor eps_op ~ 5e-5, negligible); R* and all whitening in fp64.
implications_for_architecture: Build M0 = 'predicted local energy + exact coarse condensation' on the existing COLLAR_1 kinematics, oracle and evaluator: full-3D input (65^3 x 11 analytic fields + exact discrete channels), a small (<=2M parameter) 3D CNN with O_h group convolution (or x48 augmentation plus inference-time symmetrisation of the coefficient field), stride-2 features aligned to the 16^3 coarse grid, receptive field of a coarse cell plus its 26 neighbours (global coupling is done by the solve), per-cell head emitting 21 log-Cholesky numbers around a homogenised baseline (1096 cells -> 23k numbers on 0328), exact fp64 assembly + condensation, Shat = B^T Ahat B. Losses: stage 1 supervised regression to per-cell targets (fitted D*_c where available, oversampled local-solve tensors elsewhere); stage 2 whitened extreme-mode + bulk loss through the condensation with adjoint gradients. V1's failure mode is avoided point by point: local targets (not factor entries), interior visible (not 6 faces), no learned global heads (no 512-column modal head), scaled O(1) outputs, exact rigid/SPD/equivariance structure. Precision: bf16/fp32 in the trunk and heads, fp64 in every additive formation, condensation, Cholesky and whitening; fp64 work limited to O(k) solves per step. The day-one falsifier uses existing artefacts: (1) log-space noise sensitivity of the fitted D*_c at 1e-3/1e-2/1e-1 -> required tensor precision; (2) within-cell identifiability: regress D*_c on local descriptors with 20% of cells held out, substitute, recondense, full spectrum (pass: eps_op within ~2x of 0.15; fail: worse than the zero-learning 0.855 -> non-identifiable, regularise around the local-solve tensor and repeat once); (3) leave-one-seat-out with the small CNN on 4-8 training seats, full spectrum on a dev seat (held-out eps_op <= 0.3 -> proceed to core enrichment and the local-label engine; >> 1 with training at the floor -> data/identifiability; training far above the floor -> encoder/inputs/scaling). Inference cost (~30 s today, dominated by fine-collar assembly and pre-elimination) is not what this experiment tests and is addressed afterwards by a learned local collar or GPU cut-cell assembly.
hard_constraints: [METRIC] Acceptance is eps_op = max|mu-1| over all 12,792 whitened directions; D/d and every averaged loss can be off by ~100x (D/d 1.27e-5 with eps_op 0.229; 3 modes decide). Work gate +-10%, target +-3%.

[METRIC] cond(A) = 7.2e4 (lambda 4.9e-7..3.5e-2): additive error on A must be <= 1.46e-8 in spectral norm worst case (4.2e-7 relative); multiplicative error on the factor costs eps_op ~ 1.42||Delta||, so +-3% needs ||Delta|| ~ 2.1e-2.

[ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS] Entry-wise: ~5.5e-5 relative per entry on A, ~2.7e-4 (independent) / ~1.2e-4 (block-coherent) on the factor, under the most optimistic (entry-relative) noise model; a tensor-RMS perturbation of the old backend's diagonal parameters at 1e-3 widened the spectrum from [0.863,1.114] to [0.707,1.377]. Which noise model a real network's residual follows is unknown.

[STRUCTURE OF S] 99.87% of off-diagonal energy within 0.05 but bandwidth is not a lever: truncating the true factor to any spatial band fails (eps_op 58 at radius 0.25, ~300 damaged modes at every radius, mu_max 59-144); soft-direction stiffness is a near/far cancellation of ratio 1e3-1e4; far-field face-face blocks are low rank (top-8 singular values >= 99.5%).

[REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a] Hierarchical low rank of R* passes +-3% at 12.23M numbers (14.95% of dense) on 0328 and 13.9-15.6% on four seats with ranks chosen by inspecting true blocks (adaptive); fixed-rank count unmeasured; SVD factors are gauge-non-unique so block products/actions, not factor coefficients, are the only legitimate targets; near-field dense blocks are 3.0M of the 12.2M numbers.

[REPRESENTATIONS TRIED e] Collar + coarse core: 23,016 parameters reach eps_op 0.15; zero-learning Galerkin collar gives mu in [1.000, 1.855] (>= 1 exactly); a Loewner bound proves the fixed one-layer collar with a Q1 core cannot pass +-10% (mu_max >= 1.111) for any PD material; end-to-end cost for a new geometry ~30 s (assembly 17.7 s + compile 3.7 s + pre-elimination 7.7 s) and still depends on the fine factor.

[REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b,c,d] Free dense factor is reachable (Newton+Armijo with column scale 1/sqrt((A^-1)_jj): mu in [0.956,1.047] in 228 steps; raw Adam NaNs); banded L + low-rank softening M is one-sided and its measured L's have lambda_min(H0) 0.02-0.13 << 0.9; T^T D T descended at 7.4M params reaches eps_op 15.2, 37x worse than the unfitted H-matrix at fewer params; pure block-diagonal is 63-204x above the +-10% necessary line.

[GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY] The teacher's label map is discontinuous in eps_op: +0.01% thickness -> one direction +59.8% (stiffness 1.1e-6 = 0.014% of mean) via a 5.6e-15 volume-fraction cell and 3 new GP faces; full-operator central differences disagree by 87% between h = 1e-4 and 1e-3; the 6-D end-load compliance derivative is stable to 0.023%; the internal-extension prototype's hard classifier jumps mu_max to 1.25 under a 1e-12 threshold shift; production labels use the original GP. Cross-seat operators differ by eps_op 536-3847 at geometric distance 0.14-0.36: no zero-shot transplant.

[STRUCTURE OF S] The softest modes are numerically measurable (min E/N = 1.5e27, nothing to mask) and mostly physical thin-material modes (188 modes < 1e-6 without fragment dominance, ~6 fragment modes); they vary along thin curves and oscillate across thickness, and no fixed geometric coarse basis contains them (stride-2 Q2 face basis 33%, material-graph Laplacian 3000 columns 72% of their energy).

[LEARNING ATTEMPTS] V1 (6-face CNN, 54 channels, receptive radius 0.23, 0.59M params, banded L + rank-512 M, 26 FULL labels) plateaued at e_A 27% on train and held-out with mu_max up to 670; the same bounded parameterisation optimised freely on 0328 reached mu in [0.441, 1.946] (e_A 6.5%) with 46% of modal-head parameters saturated; ten earlier dense-factor + Frobenius rounds stuck at the diagonal-only error 38.8%, removed only by rigid invariance by construction; an unseen symmetric frame made V1E numerically singular (mu_min ~1e-17, mu_max ~1200).

[ASSEMBLY / DELIVERABLE] The deployed operator must literally be Shat = B^T Ahat B; exact condensation composes to 1e-12; teacher validated against an independent Tet10 reference to 0.05-0.10% compliance on assembled FULL structures; for the H-matrix modules displacement error ~ eps_op/4 (monotone) and compliance error <= 0.31% at eps_op 0.15, but compliance is first order in general (dC = -u^T dK u) and this construction's small value is construction-specific; design sensitivities untested; deployment mode A vs B undecided (B loosens the gate ~30x but needs the true operator's action, i.e. the elimination being avoided).

[GOAL] Data: 33 seats with factors, all FULL (no CUT labels); condensed S exists for 1024 geometries (float32 packets; R* float64); q ranges ~3k-47.8k so the output dimension is geometry-dependent; the cube group's 48 operations are exact node/component permutations; registered train/dev/holdout splits must not be crossed by screening.

Precision: fp32 unit roundoff 6e-8 times cond(A) = 4.3e-3, times d = 7.6e-4 in accumulated dot products; any additive formation/condensation/whitening of a 12.8k operator judged in the whitened metric must be fp64; fp32 is acceptable only for O(1) quantities in a multiplicative gauge; the Newton factor fit stalled at the fp32 line-search floor.

Cost comparison: teacher condensation 31.85 s on 64 cores (~2e3 core-seconds); the elimination-tree profile puts 0.1% of the work in leaves and 26.5% at the root, so 'learn the leaves, eliminate the rest exactly' saves nothing unless the exactly-eliminated system is coarse; inference-time coarse solves are presently disallowed by the roadmap pending the user's decision (3); like-for-like comparison must include the assembled solve on both sides.
open_questions: Which noise model resembles a real network's residual (entry-relative, row-absolute, tensor-RMS, spatially coherent)? Only real held-out residuals can answer; the 1e-4 per-entry figure is model-dependent.

Are the fitted core material tensors D*_c an identifiable, local, smooth function of geometry, or do many interior configurations give the same boundary response? (day-one test; regularisation around the local-solve homogenised tensor if not)

Is the 60%-jump mechanism boundary-only: do interior active-set switches enter S only smoothly (O(gamma) relative) while boundary switches jump, so that an exactly assembled fine collar captures every discontinuity? (activate an interior sliver, measure eps_op change)

Are the softest ~200-1000 modes stabilisation-defined (values set by the GP face set at the 1e-4 x mean-stiffness scale)? (gamma -> 2 gamma two-teacher whitened spectrum; modes moving > 3% cannot be legitimate +-3% targets)

Accuracy contract: unfloored module eps_op vs stiffness-floored eps_op (shifted whitening) vs task-level with registered loads and adjoint sensitivities on the 2-cell/2x2x2 harness; sensitivities have never been measured and are first-order in the operator error.

Deployment mode A (proxy) vs B (preconditioner + refinement); for B, what is the true cost of the operator action per TO iteration (interior solves per cell) and does a coarse-model-preconditioned iterative interior solve make it affordable?

Can the fine collar be replaced by a learned local collar trained on local condensation labels, and can cut-cell assembly + pre-elimination be brought from 25 s to ~1 s (GPU, patch-parallel), so that M0-class inference is ~1-5 s per cell?

Fixed-rank parameter count of the H-matrix (ranks per level chosen without peeking) and the per-number tolerance of block products/actions as targets; is H^2/nested-basis sharing enough to shrink the far-field 9M numbers substantially?

Does the geometry-predicted compliance scale (leave-one-seat spread 16.8, oracle floor 1.13-1.21) suffice for a factor-type fit without the teacher, and does the residual spread cost accuracy in the softest columns?

How does the Loewner ceiling of the collar+core family move with a Q2 core, thicker collar, GMsFEM-like enriched local bases, or a PSD softening term, and at what condensation cost per cell? (priceable with the oracle/bound tools before training)
CUT labels: none exist with factors; does the per-node/per-element architecture transfer to cut-plane traces, and what changes in the trace functionals?

How many modes of the +-3% gate lie below a defensible stiffness floor, and what does the floor do to the parameter count of every representation (the H-matrix cost at +-10% is 11.8-13.6% of dense; the collar model already sits at 0.15)?
Exact O_h equivariance vs augmentation + inference-time symmetrisation: what does each buy in held-out eps_op at 33 and at 1024 labels?
Is the interior-blind 6-face input the dominant cause of V1's plateau, or the non-local target? (ablation: same heads with full-3D input vs same input with local targets)

FROM GEOMETRY TO THE INTERFACE SCHUR COMPLEMENT: A FIRST-PRINCIPLES ANALYSIS
(operator-learning / scientific-ML lens; all project numbers cited by tag; repository records used where they sharpen the tags)

0. WHAT THE OBJECT IS, AND THE TWO PRINCIPLES EVERYTHING ELSE FOLLOWS FROM

S is the discrete Dirichlet-to-Neumann (Poincare-Steklov) operator of a linear-elastic thin-sheet body on the cell boundary, S = K_bb - K_bi K_ii^-1 K_ib. Everything that makes it hard to learn is visible in that formula.

- K_bb and K_bi are local (assembled from fine elements and ghost-penalty faces); all non-locality enters through K_ii^-1. That inverse is dense, its far field is smooth (a Green's function) and therefore blockwise low rank: this is why a hierarchical low-rank approximation of R* passes +-3% at 15% of dense with no fitting [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a] and why a band fails at every radius [STRUCTURE OF S].
- The subtraction is a cancellation. In the softest directions the near-field part and the K_bi K_ii^-1 K_ib part are each 1e3-1e4 times larger than their difference [STRUCTURE OF S]. Any representation that produces the two parts separately (a band plus a correction; a factor whose entries are regressed one by one) must produce each to 1e-3-1e-4 of its own size, which is exactly the measured ~1e-4 per-entry requirement [ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS]. A representation that produces S as the result of a condensation (the difference is computed, not predicted) does not pay this.
- The acceptance metric is the worst direction in the teacher's energy norm with cond(A) = 7.2e4 [METRIC]: additive error is amplified by cond(A), multiplicative error on the factor is not, and an average over 12,792 modes cannot see the 3 modes that decide a verdict.

Two principles follow and are used in every section below.

P1 (division of labour). The network predicts only quantities that are (i) local functions of geometry, (ii) O(1) after a geometry-computable scaling and (iii) needed to ~1e-2 relative accuracy. The exact, precision-critical, global part of the map (the elimination that produces the cancellation and the far field) is linear algebra inside the model, in fp64. Every attempt that violated P1 failed the way P1 predicts: Frobenius-fitted dense factors (diagonal attractor), the V1 CNN emitting factor entries (27% plateau), banded L + low-rank M (one-sided), truncation (cancellation).

P2 (structure by construction, not by loss). SPD, exact rigid null space, cube-group equivariance and Galerkin monotonicity go into the parameterisation. The 38.8% diagonal attractor disappeared only when rigid invariance was built in [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]; V1's instability on an unseen symmetric frame (mu_min ~1e-17, mu_max ~1200, repository record of 2026-09-12) is what augmentation-only equivariance buys.

1. THE OUTPUT-SIZE PROBLEM

Scale: d = 12,792; d^2 = 1.64e8; upper triangle 8.18e7 entries; dense fp32 655 MB, fp64 1.31 GB per cell; Cholesky d^3/3 = 7e11 flops (~1 s at 1 TFLOP/s fp64); dense matvec 3.3e8 flops (~1 ms). Across the 1024 identities q ranges ~3k-47.8k, so the output dimension is itself geometry-dependent (active boundary nodes): every viable architecture emits per node / per block on the fixed grid with the exact active mask computed analytically from the level set. There is no fixed-size head.

(a) Flat heads. A linear head from a hidden vector of width h to 8.2e7 outputs has 8.2e7 x h weights (h = 256: 2e10 weights, 84 GB fp32), one weight per output learned from <= 1024 examples. Impossible and structurally wrong (no weight sharing, no locality, no SPD).

(b) Query-based decoders. Predict S_ij or R_ij = f(phi_i, phi_j, x_i - x_j, geometry context) from per-node embeddings. Compute is not the issue: 8.2e7 queries x 1e4 flops = 8e11 flops, 0.1-1 s per cell on one GPU, streamed; 330 MB output. The issues are accuracy and structure. Entry-wise prediction of A needs ~5.5e-5 relative per entry, of the factor ~2.7e-4 (independent errors) or ~1.2e-4 (block-coherent) [ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS]; in my experience geometry-conditioned regression heads in operator learning reach 1e-2-1e-3 relative error on smooth PDE maps, and nothing in a pointwise decoder makes the near/far cancellation come out right, because both contributions are emitted by the same regression with the same relative error. A pointwise S is not SPD; a pointwise Cholesky factor R gives A = R^T R >= 0 by construction, and the Cholesky factor in a fixed ordering is a unique, continuous label, but its entries are not local functions of geometry (column j is determined by the elimination of everything ordered before j; the fill does not decay with physical radius: truncation at 0.35 damages as many modes as at 0.2). Verdict: not viable as the sole mechanism; fine as the emission mechanism for local blocks of a structured representation (near-field leaf blocks, element matrices).

(c) Kernel / attention formulations. Softmax attention over 12.8k boundary dofs costs d^2 k flops per head (k = 64: 1e10) and 655 MB per head in fp32, so a few heads are affordable, but an attention matrix is positive and row-stochastic, the wrong sign structure for a stiffness operator (rows sum to zero on rigid modes, off-diagonals negative in the coupling sense), and linear-attention/Gram forms S = Phi Phi^T are low rank while the near field of S is full-rank dense (1344-2432 dense leaf blocks, 3.0M numbers) [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]. The only Gram-type construction that gives a full-rank, sign-correct SPD operator from per-node features is S = sum_e Phi_e^T C_e Phi_e with local Phi_e and small SPD C_e, i.e. an assembled finite-element-like operator; that is the collar/core representation [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED e], not attention. Attention belongs in the encoder (global context for local coefficients), never in the operator's form. A translation-modulated far-field kernel S_ij ~ sum_h a_h(x_i) kappa_h(x_i - x_j) b_h(x_j) is a defensible prior for a homogeneous exterior, but here the far field passes through the sheet, which is exactly what the geometry input is about.

(d) Hierarchical decoders (predict the H-matrix). The known-good compressed form of R* has 12.23M numbers on 0328 (15% of dense; 13.9-15.6% on four seats): 2432 dense near-field blocks (3.04M numbers) plus 5930 admissible blocks with adaptively chosen ranks (9.2M numbers) [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED a]. Three quarters of the numbers are in the far field, where the cancellation lives. A learnable version needs fixed ranks per level (count unmeasured; 12.23M is optimistic), block products or actions as targets (SVD factors are gauge-non-unique), a per-block small network conditioned on the two clusters' local geometry and relative position, and it is SPD by construction only if the predicted object is a factor. Compute and memory are trivial (~50 MB, <1e9 flops per assembly); an H^2/nested-basis variant would share cluster bases across blocks and cut the far-field count. But the learning problem is ~1e7 numbers per cell at ~1e-4 each from 33 (or 1024) cells. I rate it the right storage/compression format for outputs and the right evaluation reference, not the right learning target.

(e) Learned coarse fields + fixed exact condensation. The network predicts a coarse SPD operator (per-coarse-cell material tensors, or richer local element matrices); an exact fine collar handles the boundary layer; exact condensation of the hybrid system yields Shat. Learned numbers: 23k (6x6 per Q1 core cell) to a few million (enriched elements). Achieved: eps_op 0.15 on 0328 with 23,016 fitted parameters; with the true material and no learning mu in [1.000, 1.855] (Galerkin monotonicity, exactly >= 1); Loewner bound: the fixed one-layer collar with a Q1 core cannot pass +-10% for any PD material (mu_max >= 1.111) [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED e]. Cost today ~30 s for a new geometry (local assembly 17.7 s + compile 3.7 s + collar pre-elimination 7.7 s), i.e. not yet beating the teacher; the elimination proper is 62k dofs (0.73 s factorisation + ~4 s Schur export for 12.8k right-hand sides), 0.076x the teacher's factorisation. The condensation is cheap; the fine collar's cut-cell quadrature and the 12.8k-RHS export are the engineering items.

Summary (estimates unless marked measured): flat head, >= 2e10 weights, not viable; pairwise decoder, 8e11 flops, per-entry tolerance 5.5e-5 (A) / 1.2-2.7e-4 (factor) measured, SPD only via a non-local factor; attention, 1e10 flops and 655 MB per head, wrong sign/rank structure; H-matrix decoder, 12-14M numbers per cell measured (adaptive ranks), <1e9 flops, ~50 MB, per-number tolerance ~1e-4, SPD not by construction unless factor; coarse fields + exact condensation, 2e4-3e6 learned numbers, exact part 1e11-1e12 flops fp64 (~1-5 s on one GPU), SPD/rigid/Galerkin by construction, ceiling set by the coarse space (measured >= 11% error for the Q1/one-layer version).

2. INDUCTIVE BIASES THAT MATCH THE PHYSICS

Locality and multiscale. 99.87% of off-diagonal energy within 0.05 [STRUCTURE OF S] describes the K_bb-like near field; the whitened metric cares about the energy-negligible, spectrum-decisive far field. The correct multiscale statement is not 'near field dense + far field low rank as independent outputs' but 'local operator + global elimination': the far field of S is generated by the inverse of a local operator. That is the FE / H^2 / multigrid structure; representation (e) has it by construction, (d) imitates it.

Translation on the background grid. The continuum physics is translation-invariant; the discretisation is grid-locked (cut patterns, GP faces). Weight sharing of a 3D CNN over the fixed grid is exactly right for local coefficients (material -> local stiffness is the same map everywhere); the cut-pattern dependence lives in the inputs (analytic fields sampled at the nodes, exact active/GP masks). The cell boundary breaks translation; coordinate and face channels (V1 had them) restore position where needed. Integer-grid translations are exact symmetries of the local map away from the boundary; nothing is exact for fractional ones, so impose nothing beyond weight sharing.

Cube group O_h (48 operations). The action is exact: S(g.geom) = P_g S P_g^T with P_g a node permutation composed with the signed 3x3 permutation on displacement components [GOAL]. Three uses: augmentation (V1G at probability 0.5 was unstable on unseen frames: a measured warning), exact equivariance by construction (group convolution over O_h on the 3D grid; per-cell SPD tensors transform as rank-2 tensors, per-node vectors as vectors; the option I would take with <= 1024 examples), and inference-time symmetrisation (average the 48 frame predictions of the coefficient field: exact equivariance for free plus averaging of independent error components by up to sqrt(48) ~ 7, at 48 encoder passes and one condensation).

Rigid-body invariance by construction. Assemble from local pieces with exact element rigid null spaces (K_e = Z_e^T C_e Z_e, Z_e r_e = 0); the assembled S then annihilates global translations and rotations exactly, and the diagonal becomes a consequence of the off-diagonals (row sums vanish on translations), which is precisely why the diagonal-only attractor cannot exist in such a parameterisation [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]. Working on the quotient A = B S B^T is fine for the loss (B is fixed; quotient coordinate j is physical dof order[j+6] to 0.1% energy) but the deployed object must be Shat = B^T Ahat B [ASSEMBLY / DELIVERABLE].

SPD by construction. Cholesky-parameterised local blocks, factor forms A = R^T R, and condensation of an SPD coarse system all give PSD by construction; condensation of a true-energy subspace additionally gives Galerkin monotonicity (mu >= 1 exactly, measured 1.000), so the sign of the structural error is known before training and a learned softening of the material is what the fit uses.

What the biases cannot do. The softest modes are physical thin-material modes that vary along thin curves and oscillate across thickness; no fixed geometric coarse basis holds them (a stride-2 Q2 face basis captures 33% of their energy, a support-weighted material-graph Laplacian basis with 3000 columns 72%; repository backend checks of 2026-09-12). Multiscale biases must therefore be material-adaptive (learned, or material-graph based); the collar's Loewner bound is the measured form of this statement.

3. WHAT THE V1 FAILURE MEANS AND WHAT CHANGES IT

Facts: 6-face 65x65 images, 54 channels (analytic-field slices at depths 0/1/2/4, mask, support, coords, face id), 4 dilated residual blocks, receptive radius 0.23, 0.59M parameters; heads = diagonal (bounded log correction), pair (bounded 3x3 blocks on near-field pairs), modal (512 columns per dof); Shat = L^T (I + M M^T)^-1 L; 26 FULL labels; plateau e_A ~27% on train and held-out; mu_max up to 670 [LEARNING ATTEMPTS]. Two further measured facts fix the diagnosis: the same bounded parameterisation optimised freely on 0328 reached mu in [0.441, 1.946], e_A 6.5% in 3000 steps (so the representation did not plateau; the geometry -> coefficient path did), and the free factor needed the column scale 1/sqrt((A^-1)_jj) to converge at all (raw Adam NaN) [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b].

Diagnosis, most to least likely:
(1) Non-local targets from local inputs. Entries of L are entries of a triangular factor; column j depends on the elimination of everything before it, and the fill does not decay with physical radius. A CNN of receptive radius 0.23 on face images cannot represent that dependence at any capacity; the plateau is the best local proxy (diagonal plus near-field pattern), which is why 27% sits between the diagonal-only floor (38.8%) and the free fit (6.5%). Train = test is what a representationally impossible target looks like, not evidence that generalisation is solved.
(2) Interior blindness. S depends on the whole interior through K_ii^-1. Depth slices at 0/1/2/4 grid cells see the outer 12.5% of the cell; the coupling of two faces through the sheet is not in the inputs. The 12-parameter family makes the faces determine the geometry in principle, but 'invert to global parameters, then synthesise global coupling' is not what a local CNN does.
(3) Output scaling. Entry curvature spans ~1e4 across columns (compliance); a head shared across nodes receives gradients dominated by stiff columns and never learns the floppy ones, which then come out at typical magnitudes: the operator is far too stiff in soft directions (mu_max 670 is over-stiffness). The fix is measured: compliance predicted from local features (R^2 0.98 within a cell; leave-one-seat-out spread median 16.8 from ~1e4) as the output scale.
(4) Global outputs from local features. The modal head emits 512 global columns per dof from local features; a mode needs coherent phase across the cell, which a radius-0.23 CNN can only get from coordinate channels. Measured symptom: 46% of modal-head parameters saturated at |tanh| > 0.99 in the free fit. Global low-rank structure must come out of an exact solve (or a global mechanism in the encoder), not out of per-node heads.
(5) Loss. Probe/energy and averaged whitened losses drove the bulk and were blind to the deciding modes; but the plateau is a bulk error, so the loss did not cause 27%; it caused mu_max 670 to be invisible during training.
(6) Capacity and data. 0.59M parameters and 26 labels are not binding for a local target with 4266 nodes per cell (1.1e5 node examples x48); they are binding for any global target.

What changes it, in order of leverage: make the learned quantities local by putting the global elimination inside the model (P1) or at least choose targets that are local functions of geometry (element matrices, near-field blocks, compliance scales), never factor entries; full 3D input (65^3 fields, exact active/GP masks) rather than 6 faces; exact rigid invariance, SPD and cube-group equivariance in the parameterisation (P2); per-element/per-node heads with weight sharing only, no learned global heads; output normalisation by geometry-predicted scales so heads emit O(1) numbers and one learning rate serves all columns; worst-direction supervision (section 4) on top of a bulk loss; 1024 labels instead of 26 (section 6).

4. LOSSES

Why Frobenius and mean divergence fail here. Frobenius weights modes by lambda^2: a 100% error in a mode of stiffness 1e-6 of the mean changes ||A||_F by ~1e-6 relative, invisible, while the whitened metric sees mu = 2. The divergence D/d = mean(mu - log mu - 1) is whitened, convex in Ahat, and punishes over-softness harder than over-stiffness (f(0.07) = 1.74 vs f(1.2) = 0.018), so its failure is not asymmetry; it is dilution by d = 12,792: D/d = 1.27e-5 clears the +-3% necessary line by 36x while eps_op = 0.229 fails +-10%, three modes deciding [METRIC]. Every mean-over-modes loss shares this (action-MSE equals 2 D/d to third order near the gate). Conclusion: a bulk loss is needed for shaping and conditioning; an explicit extreme-direction term is needed for acceptance.

Training against the worst direction at scale. M(theta) = R*^-T Ahat(theta) R*^-1; eps_op = ||M - I||_2.
- Extreme eigenpairs: warm-started block Lanczos / LOBPCG on M for the stiff end and on M^-1 (the pencil (A, Ahat)) for the soft end, 32-64 modes per end (8-mode blocks with 2 iterations per step, as run before, cannot track drifting extremes). Each matvec with M costs two triangular solves with R* (3.3e8 flops, fp64) plus one action of Ahat. For a condensation-type model both Ahat v and Ahat^-1 v are sparse solves with the coarse system (milliseconds); for a dense or H-matrix Ahat the soft end needs a Cholesky of Ahat (7e11 flops fp64, ~1 s) or Chebyshev-filtered subspace iteration.
- Gradients by Hellmann-Feynman: d mu_k / d theta = v_k^T (dM/dtheta) v_k = w_k^T (dAhat/dtheta) w_k with w_k = R*^-1 v_k held fixed (envelope theorem; a valid subgradient at degeneracies; no eigen-backprop, no eigh, which NaNs on repeated eigenvalues). For Ahat = exact condensation of K(theta): w^T Shat w = min over interior u of [w; u]^T K [w; u], so d(w^T Shat w)/d theta = u~^T (dK/dtheta) u~ with u~ the K-harmonic extension of w; the gradient with respect to each element's material is the strain energy of the worst modes' extensions in that element. Per step: k sparse solves and k local strain evaluations. This is adjoint sensitivity analysis, identical in form to TO sensitivities.
- Loss shaping: L = sum over both ends of psi_eps(mu_k) + w_bulk D/d, psi_eps a hinge or barrier on |mu - 1| - eps (the log-barrier -log(1+eps-mu) - log(mu-1+eps) is self-concordant and pairs with Newton-type steps; the hinge is more robust). Curriculum eps: 0.3 -> 0.1 -> 0.03; at each stage the hinge acts only on violators and tightening moves the active set. Penalising many modes per end avoids whack-a-mole where fixing mu_max reorders the spectrum (V1G: mu_max 15 -> 5, mu_min 0.13 -> 0.05; that trade also reflected a class that could only soften).
- An eigenvector-free alternative: Hutchinson spectral moments E_z[z^T (M - I)^(2p) z] = sum (mu_i - 1)^(2p); p = 8, 16 probes -> 256 matvecs (~1e11 flops, 0.1-1 s), autograd through matvecs; a soft max over modes, unbiased, cheap to combine with the Lanczos term.
- s* = 2/(mu_max + mu_min) after any fit strictly improves eps_op but uses the teacher spectrum: a diagnostic, never for held-out acceptance.

R* as preconditioner of the loss. With Rhat = (I + Delta) R*, M = (I + Delta)^T (I + Delta) and eps_op ~ 1.42 ||Delta||_2: in the multiplicative gauge the loss Hessian is essentially the identity, whereas in raw entries of Ahat it is (I kron A^-1) with condition cond(A) = 7.2e4 [METRIC]. That is why Newton with the column scale converged in 228 steps and raw Adam NaN'd [REPRESENTATIONS TRIED b]. Rules: whiten with R* in the loss at training (two triangular solves per probe), never in the forward model; choose output parameterisations already in a multiplicative gauge (log-Cholesky of local SPD blocks around a geometry-computed baseline; factor forms) so the network's own gradient conditioning matches; compute R* for every training geometry (section 6); second-order or K-FAC-style optimisers are appropriate because the whitened objective is smooth and well conditioned.

Metric variants. The evaluator's shifted whitening (spectrum under (A + cE), the existing --shift-c) is the tool for a stiffness-floored contract (section 7). A sandwich/Loewner loss with a floor, (1-eps)(A + delta F) <= Ahat + delta F <= (1+eps)(A + delta F) with F a fixed SPD floor operator, leaves modes below delta ||F|| needing only absolute accuracy.

5. PRECISION

Numbers: fp32 unit roundoff u32 = 6e-8, fp64 u64 = 1.1e-16; cond(A) u32 = 4.3e-3, cond(A) u64 = 8e-12; sqrt(d) u32 = 6.7e-6, d u32 = 7.6e-4.
- Anything that forms A or S additively and is judged in the whitened metric must be fp64: a rounding-level additive error u32 ||A|| gives, worst-aligned, eps_op ~ cond u32 = 4e-3 (marginal), and after fp32 accumulation over 12.8k-term dot products (R^T R, condensation updates) up to d u32 cond ~ 50 in the worst alignment; typical random-alignment values are ~1e-3, but the criterion is a max, not a typical value. The interior solve of a CutFEM Q2 system with GP (cond(K_ii) plausibly 1e6-1e8) in fp32 is useless (cond u ~ 0.1-10); it must be fp64 or mixed precision with fp64 residual refinement.
- The network's outputs do not need fp64 if they live in a multiplicative gauge: local SPD blocks or factor-like entries stored as O(1) numbers times a computed scale need 1e-2-1e-4 relative accuracy; fp32 (7 digits) and bf16 in the trunk are fine. The 1e-4 per-entry figure is a statement about regression error, not about arithmetic.
- Loss arithmetic: a per-entry loss meant to resolve 1e-4 relative errors over 8e7 entries must accumulate in fp64 (fp32 accumulation noise ~7e-6 relative is near the signal). The Newton factor fit stalled at the fp32 line-search floor (D/d 2.1e-5, step length 0) rather than converging: the fp32 effect in a nutshell.
- Labels: the shipped S packets are float32 and R* is float64 computed from them; by the measured per-entry conversion (eps_op ~ 7.8e-5 at 1e-7 entry noise on A) the label's own rounding floor is eps_op ~ 5e-5, 600x below the target gate, negligible but a bound on what any sub-1e-4 claim can mean. All whitened evaluation stays fp64 (the evaluator does this).
- Hardware: consumer GPUs run fp64 at ~1/64 of fp32 rate (a 5090 at roughly 1.5 TFLOP/s fp64): a 12.8k Cholesky ~1 s, a coarse condensation with 12.8k right-hand sides a few seconds; data-centre parts (19-67 TFLOP/s fp64) make the linear algebra free relative to the network. Design the training loop so fp64 work is O(k) solves per step (k extreme modes), not O(d).

6. DATA

Highest-leverage action: the 1024-geometry batch has condensed S for every identity and factors for 33 [GOAL]. R* is a Cholesky of B S B^T: 7e11 flops at d = 12.8k, up to ~3.5e13 flops and 9 GB fp64 at q = 47.8k; ~1 s to ~1 min each on a GPU, hours for the batch. This turns 33 whitening metrics into 1024 and, with the exact 48-fold symmetry, ~49k cell-level examples (registered train/dev/holdout splits respected; the frozen holdout is never used for screening).

Local labels from local fine solves (the data engine). Body assembly of a full cell costs 0.44 s; a patch of 8^3 fine cells (~15k dofs) assembles and condenses in milliseconds. For every coarse cell or boundary patch, the exact oversampled local element operator (Schur complement of the fine content of the coarse cell plus a one- or two-cell ring onto the coarse cell's boundary basis) is a well-defined, piecewise-smooth local label depending only on local geometry and local discrete state. These are MsFEM/oversampled-basis quantities; their error against the global condensation decays with the oversampling width, slowly where contrast is high (thin sheets), which is why the exact global condensation of the coarse system stays inside the model. Yield: ~1e3 element labels per cell x 1024 cells x 48 symmetries ~ 5e7 labels without running the teacher. Per-node labels (compliance scales, near-field blocks) come from the existing packets at 4266 nodes per cell.

Sparse geometry sampling. 33 (or 1024) points in a ~12-dimensional parameter space do not sample g -> S: cross-seat operators differ by eps_op 536-3847 at geometric distance 0.14-0.36 [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]. What is densely sampled is local geometry: each cell has ~7.5k active fine cells and ~1.1k coarse cells with continuously varying thickness, curvature, orientation, support and cut-pattern state, so the descriptors a local head consumes are covered by tens of thousands of examples per seat. This is the entire reason to make the learned quantities local. Two practical rules: register the descriptor coverage of the training seats against the TO design range and generate cells where coverage is missing (32 s + assembly each); and treat FULL/CUT explicitly, since none of the 33 factors is a CUT label; the per-node architecture handles a cut-plane trace naturally, but CUT labels must enter training before any CUT claim.

Symmetry as data. Exact 48-fold augmentation or equivariance is the only free data; use it from the first step, not as a late add-on.

7. LEARNABILITY OF NEAR-DISCONTINUOUS MAPS

Measured facts [GEOMETRY SENSITIVITY]: +0.01% scaling of all corner thicknesses changes ||A||_F by 2.3e-4 but one direction's stiffness by 59.8% (mu_max 1.598); that direction has stiffness 1.1e-6 (0.014% of the mean, so the mean is ~7.9e-3); the perturbation activated a background cell of volume fraction 5.6e-15 and three new GP faces; central differences of the full operator at h = 1e-4 vs 1e-3 disagree by 87%, while the 6-D end-load compliance derivative agrees to 0.023%; a hard-threshold internal-extension GP jumps mu_max to 1.25 under a 1e-12 threshold change.

Mechanism (a hypothesis consistent with all of these numbers). The GP term is 1e-4 K_ghost with K_ghost of body-stiffness scale, so the stabilisation energy of a mode with O(1) derivative jumps is of order 1e-4 x 7.9e-3 ~ 8e-7: the same order as lambda_min = 4.9e-7 and as the 1.1e-6 mode. The softest few hundred modes therefore sit at the stabilisation scale; their values are set, or co-set, by the GP face set, and every cut-cell activation (a new face set) moves them by O(1). The map g -> S is smooth between activations and jumps at each one; in the whitened metric the jumps are O(1) in a handful of directions, and the switching surfaces are dense in geometry space (every cell the level set enters). The physics is not lost (the Tet10 validation and the stable 6-D derivative say the responses that matter do not depend on these modes at the 1e-3 level), but the metric asks for 3% in modes whose value is a stabilisation artefact.

Consequences for learning. A network is a continuous function of continuous inputs; near a switch it errs by at least half the jump on one side. Reproducing a 60% jump under a 1e-4 relative geometry change needs a Lipschitz constant ~6e3 in that direction, from data spaced 0.14-0.36 apart. Under the current labels and the unfloored +-3% worst-direction gate, no continuous surrogate (network, H-matrix predictor, interpolant) can pass across a neighbourhood of geometry. This is a property of the target, not of any architecture.

What to do, in order of cost:
(1) Give the discrete state to the model as input (exact active-cell mask, GP-face graph, per-cell volume fractions, all computable from the level set). The map (continuous geometry, discrete state) -> S is piecewise smooth with pieces indexed by inputs the network sees, so the network can be discontinuous exactly where the labels are. Necessary in any case.
(2) Compute the boundary layer exactly. By the mechanism above, the activations that change S at O(1) are those whose GP faces change the stiffness of boundary-visible soft modes; an exactly assembled fine collar reproduces them exactly, and interior activations enter S only through K_ii^-1 (an interior sliver contributes O(gamma) relative to its neighbours' interior stiffness), which is smooth. This is testable (activate an interior sliver, measure eps_op change) and, if true, it is the strongest argument for the collar+core family: the discontinuous part of the map is computed, the learned part is smooth.
(3) Regenerate labels with a continuous stabilisation (the user's decision 4): the internal-extension prototype already brought the neighbouring-geometry ratio to 1.016; its residual jump is a hard classifier, removable by construction with a C1 smoothstep weight of the cut volume fraction over a registered width (in the spirit of smooth aggregation, cf. the cited Badia-Neiva-Verdugo and Burman-Hansbo-Larson references). Qualify by measuring the map's eps_op-Lipschitz constant at delta = 1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2 on a few paths (target O(1-10)); then regenerate the 33 (or 1024) labels at the frozen commit [TOOLS AVAILABLE].
(4) Register a stiffness-floored contract (the user's decision 1): mu within +-eps above a floor lambda_floor, absolute accuracy eps lambda_floor below it, evaluated with the shifted whitening the evaluator already supports; set the floor from a two-teacher test (gamma -> 2 gamma: modes that move more than 3% between the two teachers are stabilisation-defined and cannot be legitimate 3% targets; note halving/doubling gamma moved compliance by only 0.007-0.04%, so the physics survives) and confirm on the assembly harness with adjoint sensitivities, since TO consumes derivatives that are first order in the operator error.

8. A CONCRETE MINIMAL ARCHITECTURE AND THE DAY-ONE FALSIFIER

Build M0: 'predicted local energy + exact coarse condensation', on the existing COLLAR_1 kinematics, oracle and evaluator [TOOLS AVAILABLE; REPRESENTATIONS TRIED e].
- Input: the 65^3 x 11 analytic fields on the fixed grid plus exact discrete channels (active-cell mask, GP-face mask, per-cell volume fraction, support measure); full 3D, not 6 faces.
- Encoder: a small 3D CNN (<= 2M parameters) with O_h group convolution (or, first, x48 augmentation plus inference-time symmetrisation of the coefficient field), stride-2 outputs aligned with the 16^3 coarse grid; a receptive field of a coarse cell plus its 26 neighbours suffices for the first test because the global coupling is done by the solve.
- Head: per coarse cell a 6x6 SPD material tensor as a log-Cholesky correction around a geometry-computed baseline (the Galerkin-restricted or volume-fraction homogenised tensor): 21 numbers per cell, 1096 cells on 0328 (23k numbers). A per-collar-patch head is off in M0 (collar exact).
- Decoder (exact, fp64): assemble K = K_collar(exact fine) + sum_c C_c^T D_c(theta) C_c; condense to the trace; Shat = B^T Ahat B. SPD, rigid null space and Galerkin structure by construction.
- Losses: stage 1, supervised regression of D_c to per-cell targets (the oracle-fitted D*_c where a seat has been fitted; oversampled local-solve homogenised tensors elsewhere); stage 2, whitened extreme-mode + bulk divergence loss through the condensation with Hellmann-Feynman/adjoint gradients (k = 32 modes per end, curriculum 0.3 -> 0.1), R* for every training seat.
- Acceptance: full whitened spectrum of frozen checkpoints on dev seats from the training partition only.

Why this first. It isolates the single untested load-bearing hypothesis of the programme, that the coefficients of a physics-structured representation are a smooth, identifiable, local function of geometry, in the setting with the fewest numbers (23k), the strongest structure by construction, an exactly known fitted floor (eps_op 0.15) and a proved ceiling (fixed collar + Q1 core cannot pass +-10%). The ceiling is not what the experiment tests; it is lifted afterwards by enriching the core (Q2 core; per-cell local element matrices from oversampled fine solves in a GMsFEM-like enriched basis, which is what thin-material modes call for; or a PSD softening term whose rank is set by the count of modes above the Galerkin bound), and the Loewner-bound tool prices each enrichment before training. If the hypothesis fails here it fails for every richer variant; if it holds, the same encoder and loss carry over. Inference cost (~30 s today, dominated by fine-collar assembly and pre-elimination, which are local, parallel, GPU-able engineering items or a second learned local head; the condensation proper is 0.076x the teacher) is not what the experiment tests. I would not build the H-matrix predictor first: it asks for ~1e7 non-local numbers at ~1e-4 each from 33 cells with no SPD guarantee, and its only advantage (it is the one thing that has passed) is as a target/compression format, which M0 keeps as its evaluation reference.

Day-one falsifier (existing artefacts, one GPU):
(1) 1-2 h: noise sensitivity of the representation. Perturb the fitted D*_c of 0328 in log space at 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1 relative, recondense, full spectrum. Output: the precision the network must reach on the tensors (the old backend's diagonal parameters needed 1e-3 [ACCURACY REQUIREMENTS]; if the core tensors need better than ~1e-2, the route is precision-limited before it is learnability-limited).
(2) 2-3 h: identifiability within one cell. Regress the 21 log-Cholesky numbers of D*_c on local descriptors of cell c and its neighbours (volume fraction, thickness statistics, orientation moments, GP-face count) with ridge/kNN, 20% of cells held out; substitute predictions for the held-out cells; full spectrum. Pass: eps_op within ~2x of 0.15. Fail: predictions from geometrically similar cells scatter the spectrum past the zero-learning baseline (0.855), meaning the fitted tensors are not a function of local geometry (many interior configurations give the same boundary response); then refit as a small deviation from the local-solve homogenised tensor and repeat once.
(3) Rest of the day: leave-one-seat-out with the small 3D CNN on 4-8 training seats' D*_c fields with x48 augmentation, evaluated by full spectrum through the exact condensation on a dev seat. Decision rule: held-out eps_op <= 0.3 -> the hypothesis survives; go to core enrichment and the local-label engine. Held-out eps_op >> 1 with training at the floor -> data/identifiability, not representation. Training far above the floor -> the encoder/head cannot express the map even in-sample, which is what V1 looked like, and the diagnosis is inputs/scaling.
The day needs no new physics code beyond substitute-and-recondense, which the collar pipeline already performs. Fitting D*_c on additional seats (3000 steps each at the collar's per-step cost) can run in parallel on the second GPU.

9. HARD CONSTRAINTS AND OPEN QUESTIONS

See the structured lists. The constraints that bind the architecture most are: the max-over-directions gate with cond 7.2e4 (P3/P4); the cancellation and the failure of bandwidth (P1/P5); the Loewner ceiling of the current coarse space; the discontinuity of the current labels at active-set changes (P7); 33 FULL labels with factors but 1024 float32 S packets; fp64 for every additive formation; and the undecided contract/deployment/inference-solve decisions, which determine whether M0's family is admissible at all. The open questions that decide the next week are cheap: identifiability and noise sensitivity of D*_c, the interior-vs-boundary switch test, the gamma -> 2 gamma two-teacher spectrum, and adjoint sensitivities on the 2-cell harness.
